title: Does Pinnacle Blooms offer therapy for adults with autism?
metaTitle: Pinnacle Blooms Network | Therapy for Adults with Autism
description: While focusing primarily on children, Pinnacle Blooms Network also provides potential support to adults living with autism. Learn more about our individualized services for all ages.
html: While our primary clientele comprises children, we at Pinnacle Blooms Network, the #1 Autism Therapy Centers Network, are highly conscious that autism doesn’t restrict itself to any age group. We believe in the right to therapy for every individual, therefore, we may cater to adults' individual needs on a case-by-case basis too.
